ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test. It is recommended to investigate the cause of the failure and optimize the page's performance by reducing the number of requests, optimizing images, minifying CSS and JavaScript files, and leveraging browser caching.
insights: The pricing page has the fastest load time, likely due to fewer resources and optimized content. This page can serve as a benchmark for optimizing other pages.
The blog page has a longer Time to First Byte (TTFB) compared to the pricing page, which might be due to server-side processing or database queries. Investigate possible optimizations to reduce TTFB.
Ensure consistent performance optimization practices are applied across all pages to maintain a high-quality user experience.
